run_mask_generation: run the script to generate instance segmentation masks for a video sequence using PointRend
run_human_mask_extraction: run the script with ishuman flag to extract person masks from video frames using Detectron2
run_nonhuman_mask_extraction: run the script to extract non-human object masks from COCO classes 14-23 in video frames
review_pointrend_predictor_setup: review the DefaultPredictor configuration for PointRend instance segmentation with X-101 backbone and 0.9 score threshold
review_mask_preprocessing_pipeline: review the frame preprocessing pipeline that resizes to 1080p, pads borders, and applies connected components filtering
